newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Motorola flat at 64.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Motorola flat at 64.

text.p: Motorola Inc was trading unchanged from its closing quote of 64 in after-hours trading following the release of the company's quarterly results, traders said Thursday.
"It's trading right in line (with the day's close)," one trader said.
The company reported fourth-quarter earnings fell to $0.39 per diluted share, including restructuring charges, from $0.72 per share a year earlier.
Secure Computing Corp went down to 7-1/2 from a close of 8-1/8 as it forecast a fourth-quarter loss of between $0.31 a share and $0.36 a share, below industry analysts' expectations.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 277,500 shares against Wednesday's 12,200 and session two had 987,800 compared to 183,400.
The American Stock Exchange reported a volume of 1,000 shares in after-hours trading.
